_readme: Every mission in the game. Editable without touching code.
A mission has: id, title, giver (where you pick it up), objectives, rewards.
goto     { x, z, radius, label }            walk there
talk     { scene, x, z, label }             walk there and press E
collect  { points: [[x,z],..], label }      pick up all of them
evade    { label }                          shake the seals off
Rewards use the same shape as dialogue effects:
{ cash, heat, cred, built, took, flags }
requires: flags that must already be set before the mission is offered.

missions.title: RENT IS DUE FRIDAY
missions.brief: Sell the tapes yourself. Nobody else is going to.
missions.outro: Ninety dollars short of rent, and the best four hours you've had in a month.

missions.title: ERRANDS
missions.brief: Kodi has a package. Kodi does not say what is in the package.

objectives.label: Back to Kodi for your money

missions.outro: Four hundred and twenty dollars for ninety minutes' walking. That is the entire problem.

missions.title: THE RIG JOB
missions.brief: Cargo off the harbour rigs. This is not walking a package about.

objectives.label: Get the crates off the pier

missions.outro: The most money you have ever held. Detective Bask now knows your name.
